name: swpanel
description: 江海冶金内部图纸自动建模与成本测算工作台
author: JANGHI

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:root && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test:root && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && playwright test --config=playwright.electron.production.config.ts && playwright test
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @swpanel/domain && npm run build --workspace @swpanel/contracts && npm run build --workspace @swpanel/runner && npm run build --workspace @swpanel/ui
scripts.build: node scripts/clean.mjs && npm run build:root && npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @swpanel/desktop
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
